changelog:
Initial release of binance-web3 skill.

- Query token prices, market data, K-line charts, and smart money trading signals using Binance Web3 APIs.
- Supports Binance Smart Chain, Base, Solana, and Ethereum networks.
- No API key or authentication required.
- Provides token search, real-time dynamic data, candlestick chart data, and professional trading signal features.
